tools.name: faf_validate
tools.description: Validate a .faf: structure errors/warnings plus the always-33 score faf-cli gives (Rust→WASM, at the edge).

tools.name: faf_score
tools.description: Score a .faf 0-100 with the always-33 faf-kernel, the same score faf-cli gives (Rust→WASM, at the edge).

tools.name: faf_read
tools.description: Parse a .faf and return its normalized structure (Rust→WASM, at the edge).
